Run a simulation study comparing all 9 partial clique implementations

run_simulation.Rd

For each combination of alpha level and trial, generates one random adjacency matrix and applies all 9 implementations of compute_maximal_partial_clique. Records the clique size, status, and validity of each result.

Usage

run_simulation(
  alpha_levels = c(0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1),
  n_trials = 10,
  n = 20,
  clique_fraction = 0.5,
  clique_edge_density = 0.95,
  time_limit = 30
)

Arguments

alpha_levels

A numeric vector of alpha values to test (each between 0.5 and 1).

n_trials

Integer. Number of trials per alpha level.

n

Integer. Number of nodes in each generated graph.

clique_fraction

Numeric. Fraction of nodes forming the planted clique.

clique_edge_density

Numeric. Edge density among planted clique nodes.

time_limit

Numeric. Max seconds allowed per implementation call.

Value

A data frame with one row per (alpha, trial, method) combination, containing:

  • alpha: the alpha level for this trial

  • trial: the trial number

  • method: implementation number (1-9)

  • clique_size: number of nodes in the returned clique (NA if error/timeout)

  • edge_density: reported edge density (NA if error/timeout)

  • true_density: verified edge density via compute_correct_density()

  • status: "completed", "timed_out", or "error"

  • valid: TRUE if the clique meets the alpha density requirement
